visual_species: Domestic three-colour Koi (Cyprinus sp.) visual study

references.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL; reference only, no photo pixels redistributed
references.observed: Live adult in top view with pearl-white body, large red head/body islands, smaller irregular dark body patches and pale spread pectorals. Original patch layout differs from the photographed individual.

limitations: Original Sanke-inspired domestic Koi visual study based on the inspected Paulman photograph. Patch layout is original and does not clone an individual; pedigree, breed grade and precise Cyprinus ancestry are not certified. The swimming loop is artist-tuned.
Carp-like mouth/barbel and fin anatomy reuses the previously reviewed original common-carp construction; the top-view photograph does not measure locomotion.
